scope: same-score denominator sensitivity in unselected SPH V1; retrospective ECG-statement transfer
denominator: all source metadata rows for flow and prevalence; all successfully scored nonconflicting source rows for statement metrics
restriction: retain scored rows with at least one of this profile's defensibly mapped statements; this is a new SPH restriction, not a replay of historical panel selection
reference: for a defensibly mapped statement, absence means not documented in SPH and is never absence of disease; Normal ECG with any other primary statement is ambiguous and excluded from metrics only

P6.1AVB: prolonged PR is only a proxy

P8.1AVB: prolonged PR is only a proxy
P8.NSR: Normal ECG is not an explicit NSR statement

P4.ISC_: ST and ST-T statements do not establish the ischemia endpoint

routing: no abstention, cascade or clinical referral executed; P8 can apply its original top-1 fallback
